# Surprise Buddy

> Surprise Buddy is an AI-powered gift recommendation app that helps users find the perfect gift for any occasion. It supports 70+ countries, 11 languages, and multiple currencies.

Surprise Buddy uses Google Gemini AI to generate personalized gift suggestions based on the recipient's age, gender, interests, occasion, and budget. Each recommendation includes a product name, description, and a direct link to shop (Amazon, Etsy, Mercado Libre, or other region-specific stores).

The app is available at [https://www.surprise-buddy.com](https://www.surprise-buddy.com).

## Supported Languages

- English (en), German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Swedish (sv), Danish (da), Norwegian (no)

All routes are locale-prefixed: `/{locale}/page`

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/en/): Gift finder form — select occasion, recipient details, interests, and budget to get AI-generated gift recommendations

## API

- `POST /api/generate`: Generate gift recommendations. Requires a JSON body with fields: country, gender, age, occasion, interests, budget (min/max), currency. Returns a JSON array of gift objects. Not publicly accessible without server-side API key.

## For AI Agents (MCP)

Surprise Buddy hosts a public **MCP server** for AI agents — search the curated, country-scoped gift database from Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible client. 5000+ verified gifts across 50 countries.

- MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0): [https://www.surprise-buddy.com/api/mcp](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/api/mcp)
- Discovery manifest: [https://www.surprise-buddy.com/.well-known/mcp.json](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/.well-known/mcp.json)
- OpenAPI 3.1 spec (for non-MCP agents): [https://www.surprise-buddy.com/openapi.yaml](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/openapi.yaml)
- Agent instructions / skill: [https://www.surprise-buddy.com/SKILL.md](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/SKILL.md)
- Developer landing page: [https://www.surprise-buddy.com/en/agents](https://www.surprise-buddy.com/en/agents) — quickstart, Claude Desktop config, ChatGPT Custom GPT setup

Tools exposed: `find_gifts`, `list_supported_countries`, `list_supported_occasions`, `list_supported_interests`, `list_supported_colors`. Authentication: none (open).

## Optional

### Interest Categories

Users can select from 100+ interest tags across 12 categories: Sports, Wellness, Learning, Tech & Gaming, Creative, Home, Outdoors, Entertainment, Fashion, Food & Drink, Music Genres, and Other.

### Supported Countries (70+)

Organized by language: German-speaking (DE, AT, CH), French-speaking (FR, BE, SN, CI, MA, and more), English-speaking (US, GB, CA, AU, IE, and more), Spanish-speaking (ES, MX, AR, CO, CL, PE, and more), Portuguese-speaking (PT, BR), Dutch (NL), Polish (PL), Swedish (SE), Danish (DK), Norwegian (NO), Italian (IT).

### Supported Currencies

EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, CAD, AUD, MXN, ARS, COP, BRL, CLP, PEN, UYU, PLN, SEK, DKK, NOK.
